title: Plan H: AI Translation / Multilingual Export
summary: Preprocess source → build glossary → AI first pass → human review → localization adaption → QA & ship
scenario: Best for going abroad: product copy, website/app multilingual, marketing content and documentation — machine translation for the base, human review for quality.

steps.title: Preprocess the source
steps.detail: Clean layout noise (extra line breaks, markup, placeholders) and flag what must be preserved. Clean input means clean output.
steps.tips: Tag placeholders like %s, {name} and {{variable}} separately so translators never touch them.

steps.title: Build a glossary
steps.detail: Collect brand names, product names, jargon and slogans into a source↔target glossary, ruling which stay untranslated and which get fixed translations. Consistency starts here.
steps.tips: Brand names usually stay as-is; feature words (e.g. 'save') get one canonical translation site-wide.

steps.title: AI first pass
steps.detail: Feed 'glossary + style requirements + source' together, translating segment by segment. For bulk, use an API or script, giving each line context to avoid mis-splitting.
steps.tips: Give the model 1-2 polished reference sentences (few-shot) for much steadier style.

steps.title: Human review
steps.detail: Review cultural context, tone and marketing hooks line by line; reflow long sentences to target-language habits. Brand-voice consistency is won at this gate.
steps.tips: Give reviewers a scope ('tone / length / culture only') so style doesn't drift while editing.

steps.title: Localization adaption
steps.detail: Localize dates, currency, units and time zones; adapt truncation and wrapping caused by different text lengths, and restore placeholders to the right slots.
steps.tips: EN→ZH often grows ~30%, ZH→EN can shrink ~30%; leave flex in your layout.

steps.title: QA and ship
steps.detail: Back-translate samples to compare semantics; screenshot key pages for truncation, overlap and untranslated leftovers before launch.
steps.tips: Run an automated 'untranslated residue scan' before release — more reliable than eyeballing screens.

pitfalls.title: Inconsistent terminology
pitfalls.detail: The same feature translated differently across pages is a going-abroad killer; build a glossary and enforce it globally.

pitfalls.title: Awkward cultural context
pitfalls.detail: Literal translation trips over memes, puns and taboos; native review is the safety net.

pitfalls.title: Lost format / truncation
pitfalls.detail: Placeholders shift and text overflows after translation; use a localization platform plus screenshot QA.

pitfalls.title: Machine-translation smell
pitfalls.detail: Pure MT reads stiff; the AI-pass + human-polish combo beats either alone.
